title: Implement observation and manual pH/EC no-data evidence records
verify: Observation records carry trust_label=untrusted_data and source refs
Manual pH/EC records support recorded, no_data, invalidated, and superseded semantics

constraints: Human-entered observations are untrusted data for later agent context
